title: Custom eggless housewarming cakes for Parramatta and Merrylands families
summary:
A housewarming in Parramatta or Merrylands usually means feeding elderly relatives who won't touch anything with egg in it. Every cake from Harris Park is 100% eggless - sponge, buttercream, ganache, across all 15 flavours. No asking what's in it. No separate order for the one aunty who checks.

48 hours minimum. Order Wednesday, collect Friday, walk it straight into the new place.

Shop 1, 96-98 Wigram Street, Harris Park. Open 11am-10pm, 7 days.
keywords: elderly relatives who won't eat anything with egg in it
